name: stacktree
description: Publish HTML to a private link that opens in any browser, with no account for the viewer. Use when you have built a report, dashboard, audit, brief, prototype or one-page site and need to put it in front of someone who is not at your terminal. Links are unguessable by default, can be passcode-gated or restricted to a company email domain, expire on a schedule, and replace in place so a URL you already sent never goes stale.
